The schedule is the main course hub. Readings refer to [*OpenIntro Statistics*, 4th edition](https://www.openintro.org/book/os/). Problem-set exercise numbers correspond to that edition.

**Weekly rhythm:** Monday lecture · Wednesday guided lab · Friday review, troubleshooting, and **On Your Own** support.

The schedule may be adjusted to match the pace and needs of the class.
